title: Astra teaches a small catcher-positioning specialist
observations: 35 privileged simulator state values: joints, joint-target error, target position/velocity, catcher normal, previous action, grasp quality, hold progress. Not a camera policy.
action: Six joint-target increments at 50 Hz; finite-torque PD underneath. No IK or BC in execution.
task: Place the gripper-held catcher rim 18 mm below the lowest point of the outer berry, center it and hold 0.4 s.
success: 3D rim-center error <5 mm, normal_z >0.96, joint speed norm <0.35, both jaws >0.2 N, tool slip <5 mm and rotation <0.15 rad for 20 steps.
failure: Unexpected robot/tool contact >0.8 N, penetration >0.8 mm, tool slip >25 mm, rotation >0.5 rad, or numerical warning. These are engineering criteria, not biological limits.
variation: Plant XYZ +/-20/20/12 mm, yaw +/-0.2 rad, stalk stiffness +/-15%; full plant joints retained. Priors, not identified real distributions.
reward_design: Dense progress and proximity reward, upright-tool term, action/jerk costs, sustained-success bonus and invalid-contact penalty. Defined before training; see source.
scope: Positioning subskill only. Catcher is prepositioned between jaws at reset; no pickup. Textile is a visual rest shape, no net/fruit contact or cutting. Self-collision disabled; uncalibrated actuators, stiffness and friction. State-based simulated generalization only.
early_stop: Two consecutive full-variation rounds with all development cases passing; success criteria unchanged.
